title: GENESIS live tick (Einklinken E2, v1 - two classes only)
description: One line per push to main, written by a GitHub Action on Build-Zeit cadence (Owner-Akt 2, 2026-09-17: not the visitor's browser clock, so no visitor data ever reaches a third party for this). The repository's own git log is the only sensor. v1 deliberately does NOT split 'betreiber' from 'bahn': every commit on this repository carries the same git author identity regardless of who or what made it (verified 2026-09-17 - git log shows one author string for the whole history), so that split has no real signal yet and this schema does not guess at it (PLAN_einklinken's own rule: unbekannt bleibt unbekannt, nie geraten). The one real, checkable signal available is whether a push added a receipts/PKT-*.json file - a guest's proof-of-work for a plug-in packet (see receipts/schemas/genesis.receipt.v1.schema.json) - which is what 'class' distinguishes.

commit.description: The commit this tick describes (main's tip at the time the Action ran).

occurredAt.description: The commit's own author date - when the change was actually made, not when this tick was generated.

class.description: 'gast': this push added at least one receipts/PKT-*.json file (a guest's returned packet). 'projekt': everything else - deliberately undifferentiated, see description above.

generatedAt.description: When the Action that wrote this line actually ran.
